BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipai Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 5-1 in the area bounded by

A line 110 feet north of and parallel to West Belden Avenue, the alley next east of and parallel to North
Maplewood Avenue, a line 83 feet north of and parallel to West Belden Avenue, and North Maplewood
Avenue

to those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2309 North Maplewood Avenue, Chicago, Illinois 60647
 2309 N Maplewood Avenue
Chicago, IL 60647
Rezoning from RS-3 to RT-4


Type 1 Narrative
Project Description: This project proposes to rezone the property located at 2309 N Maplewood Avenue, Chicago,
IL 60647 from RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and
Multi-Unit District. This rezoning is required to facilitate the second floor renovation of an existing owner-occupied
single family home. As requested by the Greater Goethe Neighborhood Association (GGNA), this project is being
submitted as Type-1 rezoning.

Proposed Land Use: Residential (Single Family)

Floor Area Ratio: 1.09

Density (lot area per dwelling): 2,970 sf / 1 unit

Off-Street Parking: 2 within detached garage

Setbaclcs:

    •    Front yard setback: 13 feet
    •    Side yard setbacks: 1.4 feet & 5 feet
    •    Rear yard setback: 41 feet

Building Height: 28.75 feet (mean height), 33.75 feet (at highest point)
